answer: The gate is saturation diver logbook: dives logged from one bell across years of deep saturation work. One fake record is cheap, but 226 aliases need 226 independent authority-backed records, and the registry check behind each is the price the farm pays. Every epoch the issuer confirms the record is still valid, and a forged or lapsed entry is struck off at once. The plume check runs in the open: 226 fakes pay the full price 226 times, one honest agent pays once, and the atlas trail in the ledger makes the summit cost visible to everyone.
